Today Apple released the first iOS 27.2 beta, in a surprising move since a 27.1 version was never released. In addition to a completely new Health app, iOS 27.2 beta 1 also expands Siri AI support to five new languages.

Siri AI adds support for French, Japanese, Spanish and other languages in iOS 27.2 beta 1

When Siri AI launched earlier this week with iOS 27, it was only available to users who had their device language set to English.

However, Apple promised at the time that more languages would be supported soon, and now if you're running the developer beta, the wait has indeed been very short.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 debuts today, bringing the following new languages to Siri AI support:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Considering this week's release only supported English, this is a significant expansion.

But now with iOS 27.2 entering developer beta, as long as your device language is set to English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese or Spanish, you can use the more powerful Siri AI.

Have you tried Siri AI on iOS 27? How does it feel to use? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
